title: Light Computer Extended Features — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. Extended features make the light computer universal and dependable: networking modules into fabrics, self-calibration against thermal drift, fault tolerance around dead components, and security for optical channels. Photonics drifts — temperature changes refractive index, so paths detune — which makes calibration a first-class feature, not an afterthought. Each feature re-expresses a conventional discipline in optics: packets become wavelength channels, ECC becomes redundant paths, firewalls become quantum-secured links.

title: Light Computer Extended Features — Photonic networking and interconnects
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. Modules link by fiber (the telecom industry's solved problem: dense wavelength-division multiplexing puts dozens of channels on one fiber) and by free-space optical links for short hops. Silicon photonics already co-packages optics with switch chips in data centers. The light computer's network is wavelength-routed: a packet's color is its destination, and passive gratings do the switching with no electronics. Bandwidth per fiber: terabits; latency: microseconds.

title: Light Computer Extended Features — Self-calibration against drift
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. A photonic chip's paths detune as temperature shifts — a fraction of a degree moves a resonator off its wavelength. Self-calibration runs continuously: pilot tones probe each path, heaters or carrier injection re-tune it, and the control loop holds everything on-wavelength. Telecom transceivers do this today; the computer scales it to thousands of paths. Calibration is the light computer's immune system: invisible, constant, essential.

title: Light Computer Extended Features — Fault tolerance in photonics
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. Emitters age, detectors go blind, waveguides crack — and the machine must not care. Tolerance comes from redundancy (spare modulators per array), rerouting (tunable splitters steer around dead paths), and graceful degradation (lose 5 percent of channels, lose 5 percent of speed, not the machine). Built-in self-test sweeps every component at boot and maps the damage, like memory testers mapping bad RAM. The contract: components fail; computations do not.

title: Light Computer Extended Features — Optical and quantum security
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. Fiber can be tapped, free-space beams intercepted — so optical networks encrypt like any network, with the bonus of quantum key distribution on the same hardware. Physical-layer defenses include spread-spectrum encoding below the noise floor and tamper-evident enclosures whose interference pattern changes if opened. The light computer's security story is conventional crypto with quantum upgrades, all native to the hardware.

body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. Like its plasma sibling, the light computer first wins as an accelerator: electronic hosts run control flow while photonic modules blast through matrix math and signal processing. The runtime schedules optical kernels, moves data over PCIe-style photonic interconnects, and hides wavelength management behind driver software. This is the proven adoption path — every successful accelerator (GPUs, TPUs) rode it — and the extended feature is the seamlessness of the ride.

title: Light Computer Extended Features — Scaling to the universal photonic platform
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. The universality checklist for light: complete logic (interferometric gates plus electronic control give it), memory (holographic and electronic), I/O (fiber everywhere), networking (wavelength-routed), and programmability (SLMs and tunable meshes). Photonic processors will not replace electronic CPUs for control-heavy code — and do not need to. Universal here means: any workload with a photonic formulation runs at full speed, and the platform keeps extending its formulations.

title: Light Computer Extended Features — The road to the universal light machine
body: Public edition. Public physics and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. The roadmap: single PIC accelerator, multi-chip modules, rack-scale photonic fabrics, hybrid datacenters, universal photonic facility. Each stage is shipping or in advanced development somewhere today — this is an engineering march, not a physics gamble. The teaching ladder follows: students go from lighting one waveguide to architecting fabrics. The light computer's future is bright in the most literal sense: it is already arriving, one wavelength at a time.
